sql.value: select p.id, p.name, p.description, p.category, p.content, p.icon, p.is_builtin, p.enable_status, p.sort, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time from ai_prompt_preset p where p.is_deleted=0 #[and p.name like :name] #[and p.category = :category] #[and p.enable_status = :enableStatus] order by p.sort desc, p.id desc
